attchmntText: Kalyani Commercials Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Kalyani Commercials Limited published its standalone un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 in the Financial Express on 14th November 2026 and Jansatta on 14th November 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during its meeting held on 13th November 2026. The outcome of this approval was previously disclosed to the stock exchanges on 13th November 2026. The company is submitting newspaper clippings to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited as required under Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The filing was signed by Sourabh Agarwal, Whole Time Director and CFO, with DIN 02168346.

attchmntText: Kalyani Commercials Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kalyani Commercials Limited reported standalone un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved the results on 13th November 2026. Revenue from operations was 13,200.51 lakhs for the quarter and 21,693.36 lakhs for the half year. Net profit was 52.10 lakhs for the quarter and 93.44 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 5.21 for the quarter and 9.34 for the half year. Total assets stood at 13,935.77 lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The company confirmed that Regulation 32 regarding statement of deviation or variation is not applicable as no funds were raised via public issue, right issue, preferential issue, or qualified institutions placement during the period.
